notes: Background: Global investment manager evaluating Redwood Private VPC to host inference for compliance-monitoring and customer-facing assistants. Strong emphasis on immutable audit trail and SIEM export.
Current stage: POC environment request w/ VPC peering and log export to Splunk/Exabeam. Security team requires example log payload, retention policy, and proof of CMK integration.
- Delivery: push logs to customer SIEM via secure syslog (TLS) OR HTTPS endpoint; optional S3 export for SFTP ingestion.
- Formats supported: JSON (ECS-compatible), CEF, LEEF. Primary ask: ECS JSON with explicit field mapping.

- Required fields: timestamp (ISO8601), request_id, user_id (pseudonymized), model_id, model_version, route_name, prompt_hash (SHA256), response_token_count, latency_ms, response_status, cost_usd, workspace_id, dataset_id (if applicable), redaction_flags.
- Access logs: auth events (token_issued, token_revoked), admin_console_logins, model_deploy/change events, key_access_events (KMS usage logs).
- Retention: default 7 years for audit trails; 1 year for session-level traces unless flagged for regulatory hold. Customer wants configurable retention per log-type.
- Security: all logs encrypted at rest with customer-managed CMK; log integrity verification (signed hashes) desired; support for HSM-backed keys and key policy mapping.
- Access controls: role-based access separation in log viewer; audit trail of who queried logs; SIEM should receive raw and redacted copies (PII-filtered).
- Delivery SLA: near-real-time (<=30s) for access/security events; batching acceptable for usage summaries (<=5m).
POC notes: need sample ECS JSON of 50 events, KMS envelope flow diagram, and Splunk HEC endpoint config. AE delivered draft doc (see drive link).
Security review timeline: initial questionnaire sent 2026-02-10; completed by customer 2026-02-18. Legal requires export controls check; privacy confirming retention compliance with FINRA.
Quotes from SecOps: 'We need absolute proof logs cannot be modified post-ingest. Also, how do you avoid storing raw prompts in logs?'
Next steps: produce SIEM schema mapping + sample events, draft KMS integration runbook, schedule SecOps deep-dive, finalize retention matrix.
